Name: D_0
dialogue: Ugh…I feel like an elephant was dropped on top of me.

Name: D_1
dialogue: I should've went to bed earlier. Gaming until 7 A.M. was an awful waste of time.

Name: D_2
dialogue: Worst of all I ended on a losing streak and demoted.

Name: D_6
dialogue: I have to get things going. The day is already halfway through.

Name: D_7
dialogue: I really thought my sleep schedule would improve after I graduated. No more homework , no internships to deal with, no brief acquaintances trying to pull me to their weird parties and social gatherings.

Name: D_8
dialogue: But all that improved was my ROL rank and my ability to procrastinate just about anything.

Name: D_9
dialogue: To think there are people out there with full-time jobs and they manage to go to the gym for hours every day.

Name: D_10
dialogue: Freaks of nature are what they are. Getting a job is hard enough.

Name: D_11
dialogue: Job hunting has been an absolutely humiliating experience!

Name: D_12
dialogue: The few interviews I got this month made me feel like a jester performing before some rich noble. I doubt they were considering anyone for that position.

Name: D_13
dialogue: Honestly ridiculous. I should get paid for all this. Having to endure such stupid interview questions is a job on its own.

Name: D_14
dialogue: "Why do you want this job?" To have money you old coot!

Name: D_15
dialogue: But, I have to keep trying. Unless I miraculously fix and sell my botched virtual assistant project, I need a job to hold me down. If I can't work, I can't eat.

Name: D_16
dialogue: It's 2 PM, right? The queue for the employment assistance center is full by now. I should occupy my time until tonight and go after jobs from other time zones. I will have my computer scour job sites for this evening. It should be able to do that without bugging out.

Name: D_17
dialogue: In the meantime, what should I? I need to prepare myself for tonight.
